_centre: After 2 km through the centre in hops (added 21 Nov 2026, the day the iPhone 13 could 'drive for a bit, then crash'). The first reading was 1058 MB in all (70 canvases, 525 on the card, 463 heap) against 553 at DRIVE (a second reading 1014), and 830 were still held 25 s after a jump back to Kvissentali: what a hand-built place paints and builds is kept once it has been visited. The limits only stop it from growing (about a tenth of room); the aim is to bring the figure down, and to lower the limits with it. Lowered from 1150 and 580 the same day, when pictures of places left behind began to rest (world/phonetex.js): 928 MB in all (71 canvases, 394 on the card with a peak of 405, 463 heap). What is left over DRIVE is mostly heap (+190) and model buffers (+80). The total lowered again from 1010 that afternoon, when the parked car models stopped holding their pictures as pixels (world/parked.js keepPacked, 50 MB): 867 MB in all. And from 945 when their detailed models were indexed in the worker and let their arrays go once on the card (76 MB of corners down to 20): 798 MB in all.

_stageDraw: Pieces and triangles drawn in a frame along the Raadi rally stage (?raadi=1), the heaviest of three views (the start line, a third and two thirds along), at the lowest level (as lowest above) and at a desktop's top level (GRAPHICS HIGH). Two runs of the check read 121 pieces and 351 thousand triangles at the lowest level (the Riia and Turu junction reads about 350 and 550), and 533 and 549 pieces, 2439 and 2450 thousand triangles at the top level (one probe that morning read 672 and 2709: which far ground squares have loaded moves it). _drive: The test drive through the centre (4.5 km, about 98 s). Set 21 Nov 2026 at about twice the readings after the freeze-frame fix (PR #372), the smaller house-front pages and Pepleri, Delta and the Catholic school built in steps. Seven drives read: the game busy for over 0.1 s 0 times (1 before those three places were stepped), longest 65 to 85 ms, 0.3 to 0.6 s in stretches over 50 ms, 95th percentile 5 to 8 ms. The code before the fix read 12 and 19 times over 0.1 s, longest 379 and 669 ms, 3.8 and 6.4 s (desktop and phone). Gaps between frames over 0.1 s: 0 or 1 after the fix (the 1 is the software drawing process stalling, which is why the longest gap has no budget), 15 and 26 before. These replace the old desktop figure (15 frames standing at the start).
_stage: A run of the Raadi rally stage (?raadi=1, added 23 Nov 2026 when Martin asked for the stage in the nightly check): 0.57 km in along Narva mnt as the stage builds itself, the start clock, then the 1.73 km stage past the finish, about 57 s. The timing budgets are the lap's.
